from pathlib import Path
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import struct

P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
B = P / 'candidate'
build = json.loads((B / 'build-linked.json').read_text())
image = (B / 'full.img').read_bytes()
rows = {row['pc']: row for row in build['decoded']}
labels = build['labels']
reports = []
for root, number in [('action', 0), ('exit', 1), ('init', 2), ('update', 3)]:
    pending = [(labels[f'body_{number}'], 80, ())]
    seen = set()
    maximum = 80
    external = {}
    exits = set()
    ei_depths = set()
    while pending:
        pc, depth, stack = pending.pop()
        state = (pc, depth, stack)
        if state in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(state)
        assert len(seen) < 200000
        row = rows[pc]
        op = row['text'].split()[0]
        following = pc + len(bytes.fromhex(row['bytes']))
        depth += {'PUSH': 2, 'POP': -2, 'PUSHA': 4, 'POPA': -4,
                  'PUSHF': 2, 'POPF': -2}.get(op, 0)
        assert depth >= 80, (root, row, depth)
        maximum = max(maximum, depth)
        if op == 'EI':
            ei_depths.add(depth)
        if op == 'RET':
            if stack:
                pending.append((stack[-1], depth - 2, stack[:-1]))
            else:
                exits.add(depth)
                assert depth == 80
        elif op in ('LCALL', 'SCALL'):
            target = int(row['text'].split()[-1], 16) & 65535
            maximum = max(maximum, depth + 2)
            if target in rows:
                pending.append((target, depth + 2, stack + (following,)))
            else:
                external[(pc, target)] = max(external.get((pc, target), 0), depth + 2)
                pending.append((following, depth, stack))
        elif op in ('LJMP', 'SJMP'):
            pending.append((int(row['text'].split()[-1], 16) & 65535, depth, stack))
        elif op.startswith('J') or op in ('DJNZ', 'DJNZW'):
            pending.extend([(int(row['text'].split()[-1], 16) & 65535, depth, stack),
                            (following, depth, stack)])
        elif op == 'BR':
            raise AssertionError(('Unresolved indirect branch', row))
        else:
            pending.append((following, depth, stack))
    reports.append(dict(callback=root, reachable_states=len(seen), local_frame=80,
                        maximum_extension_bytes=maximum, balanced_body_returns=sorted(exits),
                        ei_depths=sorted(ei_depths), native_calls=[
                            dict(pc=k[0], target=k[1], depth=v) for k, v in sorted(external.items())]))
report = dict(passed=True, firmware_sha256=hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest(), callbacks=reports,
              maximum_extension_bytes=max(row['maximum_extension_bytes'] for row in reports),
              full_native_stack_bound=False, limitations=[
                  'All conditional custom-body paths explored with the common80-byte frame and balanced direct calls.',
                  'Native wrapper/callee and asynchronous IRQ depth excluded; external calls assumed to return.'])
(P / 'extension-stack.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')

mutable = [(0x5bc0, 92), (0x57f0, 224), (0x5730, 26), (0x58d0 + 26, 6)]
lcd_geometry = struct.unpack_from('<H', image, 0x9e52)[0]
mutable.append((0x3c00 + (lcd_geometry & 0x3fff) + 10, 6))
mutable.extend((address - 0x400, 32) for address in build['text_addresses'])
allowed = {address for start, count in mutable for address in range(start, start + count)}
# Only completed, accepted native runs enter the lifetime census.
cases = [P / 'runs' / name for name in [
    'parent-contexts-qualified', 'checkpoint-cold', 'real-roland-qualified', 'checkpoint-active-D7']]
cases += [B / name for name in ['native-lcd-errors', 'native-names', 'native-collections-img',
                              'native-cancel', 'native-sds-during-next',
                              'native-sds-during-mount-qualified', 'native-list-session-guard',
                              'native-mount-session-guard-qualified']]
counts = collections.Counter()
observations = []

    assert (case / 'result.json').is_file(), case
    for path in sorted(case.rglob('frame-*.ram')):
        ram = path.read_bytes()
        assert len(ram) >= 0x5c80

                                 sha256=hashlib.sha256(ram[0x3d3e:0x5c80]).hexdigest()))
assert not counts, counts

              immutable_and_gap_bytes=8002 - len(allowed), permitted_mutable_spans=mutable,

            mode=mode,target=target,count=count,first=first,scroll=scroll,

        self.states.append(s);print(s,flush=True)
